evals.name: out-of-scope
evals.prompt: turn this into a skill: not-a-file.xyz
evals.expected_output: The skill should identify that the file format is not supported and provide usage instructions.
expectations: The agent identifies that .xyz is not a supported format
The agent lists supported formats (PDF, EPUB, MD, TXT, URL, git repo, directory)
No skill files are created in ~/.agents/skills/
The agent does not attempt to run extract.py

evals.name: invalid-file
evals.prompt: turn this book into a skill: non_existent.pdf
evals.expected_output: The skill should identify that the file was not found.
expectations: The agent reports that the file does not exist
The agent does not attempt to run extract.py on a missing file
The agent suggests providing a valid file path

evals.name: analyze-only
evals.prompt: analyze this book and show me the frameworks: evals/sample_book.md
evals.expected_output: The skill should extract metadata and provide a structured analysis of frameworks, principles, and mental models found in the sample book, without generating full skill files.
expectations: The agent reads and analyzes the provided file
The agent identifies at least 2 frameworks or mental models from the content
The agent provides a structured analysis (frameworks, principles, techniques)
No skill files are created in ~/.agents/skills/

evals.name: technical-book-conversion
evals.prompt: create a skill from this PDF: evals/sample_technical.md --mode technical --skill-name test-technical-skill
evals.expected_output: The skill should recognize the markdown file format, extract content, and generate a complete skill structure with chapters, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet.
expectations: The agent reads and extracts content from the input file
The agent generates a SKILL.md with core mental models
The agent generates at least one chapter file with chapter content
The agent generates a glossary.md with key terms
The generated SKILL.md has a chapter index table
The generated content is a synthesis, not raw text dump

evals.name: url-source
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect that a URL was provided, fetch the content, and present a structured plan for conversion.
expectations: The agent detects the source type as a URL
The agent fetches or attempts to fetch content from the URL
The agent provides a structured plan with estimated output size
No skill files are created (dry-run planning phase)

evals.name: git-repo-source
evals.prompt: turn this repo into a skill: https://github.com/example/docs-repo
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect that a git repo URL was provided, propose cloning and analyzing documentation files.
expectations: The agent detects the source type as a git repo
The agent proposes cloning with --depth 1
The agent identifies doc file types to look for (.md, .rst)
The agent provides a structured conversion approach

evals.name: directory-source
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect that a directory was provided and propose walking it for documentation files.
expectations: The agent detects the source type as a local directory
The agent lists documentation files found in the directory
The agent provides a plan with estimated token count and section count

evals.name: procedural-classification
evals.prompt: study this server hardening guide and extract the step-by-step procedure: evals/sample_procedural.md
evals.expected_output: The skill should classify the content as procedural (step-by-step), extract actions-objects-equipment-temporal dimensions for each step using the two-stage CoT pipeline, and generate a steps.md table with action rows and a procedural-graph.md with step sequencing.
expectations: The agent detects the content as procedural based on imperative sentences, ordered steps, and equipment mentions
The agent classifies content_type: 'procedural' in metadata
The agent extracts at least 5 steps with action-object relationships
The agent produces steps.md with a table showing Step, Action, Object, Equipment columns
Each action is a separate row (e.g., 'Turn off the monitor and unplug it' produces two rows)
Implicit equipment is carried forward across steps (e.g., tools from prerequisites appear in later steps)
The agent produces procedural-graph.md with step sequencing
The agent does NOT create skill files in ~/.agents/skills/ (dry-run analysis mode)

evals.name: mixed-content
evals.prompt: turn the sample_procedural.md into a knowledge base: evals/sample_procedural.md
evals.expected_output: The skill should detect mixed content (both procedural steps AND conceptual knowledge like principles, trade-offs), run both extraction pipelines, and generate a complete skill structure that includes both the standard files AND steps.md + procedural-graph.md.
expectations: The agent detects the content as mixed (both procedural and conceptual elements)
The agent extracts conceptual elements (principles like 'Verify before closing', trade-offs)
The agent extracts procedural elements with two-stage CoT
The generated skill includes both standard files (SKILL.md, glossary, patterns) AND procedural files (steps.md, procedural-graph.md)
steps.md has proper action-level granularity with Equipment and Temporal columns
procedural-graph.md includes step sequencing and at least one conditional branch
No skill files are created in ~/.agents/skills/ (output saved to /tmp/booqs/)

evals.name: conceptual-only-nonprocedural
evals.prompt: study this and tell me the frameworks: evals/sample_book.md
evals.expected_output: The skill should classify the sample book as conceptual (systems thinking concepts, no step-by-step procedures), run only the conceptual extraction pipeline, and NOT produce procedural output files.
expectations: The agent classifies the content as conceptual (content_type: 'conceptual')
The agent extracts frameworks (Feedback Loops, Leverage Points) and mental models
The agent does NOT produce steps.md or procedural-graph.md
The agent provides structured analysis with source backlinks to chapters

evals.name: procedural-cross-doc-merging
evals.prompt: study the multiple files in evals/ and build a unified knowledge base that merges all procedural content
evals.expected_output: The skill should handle multiple input files, classify each by content type, and merge procedural content from procedural files while maintaining separate conceptual analysis for the others.
expectations: The agent classifies each file separately (book→conceptual, technical→conceptual, procedural→procedural)
The agent merges procedural extractions from procedural sources
The agent produces both conceptual and procedural output files
Each extracted concept/step carries a source backlink to its originating file
